REST_CONFIRM.TITLE: Confirm Rest
REST_CONFIRM.CONTENT: Are you sure you want to rest?

COMBAT_AUTOMATION.NAME: Combat automation in chat
COMBAT_AUTOMATION.HINT: Enable combat action buttons in attack roll chat cards (dodge, parry, armor, apply damage).

REST_CONFIRMATION.NAME: Rest confirmation dialog
REST_CONFIRMATION.HINT: Show a confirmation popup before executing the Rest action on character sheets.

INJURY_HEALING.NAME: Critical injury healing countdown
INJURY_HEALING.HINT: Automatically count down each critical injury's healing time as in-game days pass on the calendar, removing the injury and announcing recovery when it heals.

MERCHANT_AUTOMATION.NAME: Merchant automation
MERCHANT_AUTOMATION.HINT: Roll availability and quantity when items are added to a merchant, and let players buy from the merchant sheet.

MERCHANT_ANNOUNCE.NAME: Announce purchases in chat
MERCHANT_ANNOUNCE.HINT: Post a public chat message whenever a character buys something from a merchant.

PRICE_MIGRATION.NAME: Price migration
PRICE_MIGRATION.HINT: Parse every item's Cost and Supply text into the module's structured price and rarity fields. The system's own fields are never changed.
PRICE_MIGRATION.TITLE: Price Migration
PRICE_MIGRATION.SCOPE_WORLD: Items in the world Items directory
PRICE_MIGRATION.OVERWRITE_HINT: Without this, only items with no price — or whose Cost text changed since the last parse — are updated.
PRICE_MIGRATION.RESULT: Price migration: {scanned} scanned, {updated} updated, {skipped} unchanged, {failed} unparsed.

MERCHANT.NAME: Merchant
MERCHANT.EMPTY: This merchant has nothing for sale.
MERCHANT.DROP_HINT: Drag items or a folder here to stock the merchant.
MERCHANT.NO_BUYER: Select a single token or assign a character to buy with.
MERCHANT.NO_PRICE: This item has no price set.
MERCHANT.NOT_ENOUGH_COINS: Not enough coins for this purchase.
MERCHANT.OUT_OF_STOCK: This item is out of stock.
MERCHANT.NO_ACTIVE_GM: No active GM — purchases cannot be processed right now.
MERCHANT.PURCHASE_FAILED: The purchase could not be completed.
MERCHANT.REROLL_HINT: Re-roll availability and quantity for everything in stock. Items that come up unavailable are removed.
MERCHANT.CLEAR_CONFIRM: Remove every item from this merchant?

ROLL.WARNING_NO_TARGET: No target selected for this attack.
ROLL.WARNING_NOT_TARGET_OWNER: You are not an owner of the target actor.
ROLL.WARNING_ACTION_FAILED: Action failed. See console for details.
ROLL.WARNING_INVALID_DAMAGE_TYPE: Could not apply damage: invalid damage type.
ROLL.WARNING_INVALID_DAMAGE_ATTRIBUTE: Could not apply damage: target has no valid damage attribute.
ROLL.WARNING_PARRY_NO_SHIELD_RANGED: Cannot parry a ranged attack without an equipped shield.
ROLL.WARNING_PARRY_NO_WEAPON: Cannot parry without an equipped melee weapon with Parrying.

CALENDAR.TITLE: Calendar
CALENDAR.STRONG_PHASE_HINT: This phase contains two full moons and strongly influences the events of the year.

ENABLED.NAME: Enable calendar
ENABLED.HINT: Enable the built-in Forbidden Lands calendar and its scene-control button.

VISIBLE.NAME: Calendar visible to players
VISIBLE.HINT: Allow players to open and view the calendar. The GM can always change the time; players only view it.

CONFIG.MENU_HINT: Configure the calendar phases, lunar cycle, and set the current date and time.
CONFIG.TITLE: Calendar Setup
CONFIG.LUNAR_EPOCH: Lunar epoch (day index of a new moon)
CONFIG.LUNAR_EPOCH_HINT: Day index that is a new moon. Adjust to align the moon phases with your campaign.
CONFIG.SET_CURRENT_HINT: These fields reflect the calendar's current date and time. Change them and press Save to update the calendar.
